title: Dageno AI 2.0
lede: Dageno AI 2.0 shows which brands ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and seven other models recommend in a market, what buyers ask them, and which sources those answers cite.

points: Version 2.0 puts market research ahead of tracking: you start from any brand or product, without connecting a website.
It covers over 12,000 niche markets and 3 million brands, and public market lookups stay free.
Each finding can be checked against the raw model answers and the pages they cite.
Paid plans keep tracking chosen questions across models and markets, with an MCP server and an API for other workflows.

sections.text: Brands working on how AI assistants describe them, and agencies handling several clients, markets and prompt sets from one account.
Public lookups are free. From the Starter plan, all 10 models and 86 countries and regions are included, with no per-model or per-region fee.
